notes: Verified clean object-first meters UI for Windows PowerShell 5.1. The release preserves the proven portal/session/account-switching logic and current-month status rule. WinForms tables no longer use DataSource; rows are rendered explicitly with DataGridView.Rows.Add. Search, shortened addresses, object filters, per-meter draft values, per-meter selection and verification remain. Meter submission is still disabled; the code contains no /meter/value request. The only POST used is the proven /account/set service call for switching accounts.
